# Onesiphorus Visits Paul (2 Timothy 1:16)

## Emotional Focus
Being a loyal friend even when times are hard.

## Key KJV
“For he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain.” (2 Timothy 1:16)

## Gentle Retelling
When Paul was in prison, Onesiphorus searched for him and brought encouragement. He was a true friend who stayed close.

## Coloring Prompt
Onesiphorus visiting Paul in prison with a kind smile and small gifts.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“True friends stick close no matter what.”
